critical_code_review_comments: Booking modal (lines 539-563): slot picker renders DAYS_FULL[slot.day_of_week] which is 'undefined' for single slots (day_of_week=null). Fix: check slot_type and use formatFullDate(slot.slot_date) for single slots.
getNextOccurrence() function (line 26-37): only handles recurring slots. For single type slots, should use slot.slot_date directly to compute next occurrence, not day_of_week math.
handleBook() (line 109-110): getNextDate(selectedSlot) will fail for single slots since day_of_week=null. Should use slot.slot_date directly for single slot scheduling.
